user.title: SH Auto Update Manager — Setup
user.description:
Select which update queues to create. Each queue manages a group of updates independently.

You can add, edit, or remove queues later in the integration options.

Uncheck all to start empty and create your own custom queues.

data.queue_0: Z-Wave Firmware — sequential, mains-powered only, manual trigger
data.queue_4: Other Updates (Matter, MQTT) — sequential, manual trigger

data_description.queue_0: Matches: zwave_js, zwave integrations. Installs one at a time. Skips battery devices.
data_description.queue_1: Matches: esphome integration. Installs one at a time.
data_description.queue_2: Matches: hacs integration. Installs one at a time.
data_description.queue_3: Matches: hassio_addons, hassio integrations. Installs one at a time.
data_description.queue_4: Matches: matter, mqtt integrations. Installs one at a time.

abort.already_configured: SH Auto Update Manager is already configured.

init.title: Queue Manager
init.description: Manage your update queues. Select an action below.

add_queue.title: Add New Queue
add_queue.description: Create a new update queue with its own match rule and settings.

data_description.match_type: How to select update entities: by integration, area, label, or specific entity IDs.
data_description.match_value: Comma-separated values for the match rule (e.g., 'zwave_js,zwave' for integration match).
data_description.exec_mode: sequential = one at a time; parallel = all at once. Z-Wave is always forced sequential.
data_description.trigger_mode: manual = start with button press; auto_on_scan = start automatically when updates are found.
